Sound familiar?

  • You don’t know how much to prep, so you over- or under-produce.
  • You get slammed with a rush and watch people walk away from long lines.
  • You juggle cash, cards, and messy order lists while trying to serve.
  • Event organizers want better reporting, but you’re stuck with receipts.

Prepay can fix this.

What prepay does for dessert vendors.

  • Predictable prep. See orders and quantities before the event so you bring exactly what you need.
  • Faster lines. Guests pick up prepaid treats with a quick scan or name check.
  • More add-ons. Use prepay to upsell combos or specialty items you can plan for.
  • Happier organizers. Give clear reports on orders, revenue, and payouts.

Your next event in four steps.

  1. Create an event. Add date, location, and pickup window.
  2. Add your menu. Shave ice sizes and flavors, desserts, combos.
  3. Share the link. Event hosts post your ScoopPass link to families and attendees.
  4. Serve prepaid orders. Pull orders as guests arrive, scan QR codes or check names.
